_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-O'yinchi ilon {width}×{height} grid da.
Siz ilonni {player_id} boshqarishni amalga oshirasiz. Muvaffiq harakatlar: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (yoki w/s/a/d).
Maqsad: eng uzoq vaqt tirik qolish yoki eng uzun bo'lish va eng yuqori ball to'plash (chegaralangan turnlar soni {max_turns} turn).

game_action.invalid_death: Ilon {player_id} noto'g'ri harakat tufayli vafot etdi.

outcome.survived_win: O'yinchi {player_id} omon qoldi; qolganlar halok bo'ldi.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Barcha ilonlar bir vaqtning o'zida o'ldi.
outcome.outlived: O'yinchi boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq umr ko'rdi.
outcome.turn_limit: To'g'ri chiziq chegarasi yetkazildi - eng yaxshi natija tenglik o'tkazadi.
